name: smwmusic-sparkster-steel-works
title: Sparkster - Steel Works
description:
A heavy rock theme from the SNES version of Rocket Knight Adventures 2. It could work in a factory / industrial setting. I could also see this being used in a fire-based level, possibly.

Channels 7 and 8 are unused, meaning in-game sound effects won't hinder the song.

Requested by Infinity.
